DDL	create table t1(a int, b int, c int) using parquet
WRITE	insert into t1 values(1,0,0)
WRITE	insert into t1 values(2,0,1)
WRITE	insert into t1 values(3,1,0)
WRITE	insert into t1 values(4,1,1)
WRITE	insert into t1 values(5,null,0)
WRITE	insert into t1 values(6,null,1)
WRITE	insert into t1 values(7,null,null)
READ	select a, b+c from t1
READ	select b + 0 from t1 where a = 5
READ	select -100 + b + 100 from t1 where a = 5
READ	select a+10, b*0 from t1
READ	select distinct b from t1
READ	select b from t1 union select b from t1
READ	select a+20, case b when c then 1 else 0 end from t1
READ	select a+30, case c when b then 1 else 0 end from t1
READ	select a+40, case when b<>0 then 1 else 0 end from t1
READ	select a+50, case when not b<>0 then 1 else 0 end from t1
READ	select a+60, case when b<>0 and c<>0 then 1 else 0 end from t1
READ	select a+70, case when not (b<>0 and c<>0) then 1 else 0 end from t1
READ	select a+80, case when b<>0 or c<>0 then 1 else 0 end from t1
READ	select a+90, case when not (b<>0 or c<>0) then 1 else 0 end from t1
READ	select count(*), count(b), sum(b), avg(b), min(b), max(b) from t1
READ	select a+100 from t1 where b<10
READ	select a+110 from t1 where not b>10
READ	select a+120 from t1 where b<10 OR c=1
READ	select a+130 from t1 where b<10 AND c=1
READ	select a+140 from t1 where not (b<10 AND c=1)
READ	select a+150 from t1 where not (c=1 AND b<10)
READ	select b, c, equal_null(b, c), equal_null(c, b) from t1
DDL	drop table t1
